subtitle: Dark Lady

lore: Jiutian represents victory and conquest—in war, but also in health and sexuality. She achieves her aims more through magic, cleverness, and skill than strength. Yet Jiutian occasionally hinders her own side, as her need for victory can blind her to other considerations, or to strategies that call for a loss now in order to attain a more significant win later.
